title: RevisionRow
description: A revision row of a revision table. To change showRevisionCallout, identify the row by row or revisionOrdinal; if both are given they must refer to the same row.

row.description: Zero-based revision row index, as the row of the revision table's cells (title and header rows are not counted)

revisionOrdinal.description: Ordinal of the revision shown in the row. Identifies the revision independently of its row, which changes with new releases and the table order.

revision.description: Revision shown in the row, e.g. "A". Read-only.

showRevisionCallout.description: Whether the revision callouts of the revision are shown. Same as the Drawing UI's "Show revision callouts"/"Hide revision callouts" on the revision row; applies to the callouts of the revision on every sheet.
